title: The Field Guide
summary: A page on every part of the game. Tips pop up as you meet each thing.
text:
You're reading it. The **Field Guide** (in the menu) has a page on each part of the game, in sections from the basics to travel between worlds.

As you play, a page is offered as a small **tip** the first time its subject turns up: your first night, your first colonist, your first contact. Read it there and then, or let it go and come back later. Each tip comes only once.

- **Show me** points at the part of the screen a page is about
- **See also** links lead to related pages
- New and updated pages are marked after each update
- The first page's tour walks round the screen again whenever you like
